inferred_style: Single-package Symfony bundle with DI extension, cache warmer, and CLI generator entrypoints; runtime behavior executes inside a consuming Symfony application.

layers.name: Consumer contract and docs
layers.responsibility: Explains install, configuration, host-app controller usage, and supported versions.

layers.name: Config tree and service wiring
layers.responsibility: Defines supported options, selects builders based on schema_type and executor, registers commands, cache warmer, aliases, and service tags.

layers.name: GraphQL code generation runtime
layers.responsibility: Builds schema from SDL, optionally extends federation schema, generates types/resolvers/registry, and writes files into the consumer-specified directory.

layers.name: Default field resolution
layers.responsibility: Provides the default resolver used by generated GraphQL code when an explicit resolver is absent.

path_mappings.maps_to: Service defaults and sample bundle config

di_service_wiring_model.summary: FlexibleGraphqlExtension::load() processes config, loads services.yaml, registers generator services, aliases the chosen type-registry builder, adds console commands, and tags a cache warmer. Resolver tagging and federation representation wiring are implemented in process().
service_discovery: Services implementing ResolverInterface, DirectiveResolverInterface, CustomScalarResolverInterface, UnionResolveTypeInterface, FederationRepresentationResolverInterface, _ServiceResolverInterface, or _EntitiesResolverInterface are tagged during process().
DefaultResolver is aliased as flexible_graphql.default_resolver and depends on a PropertyAccessor built from flexible_graphql.property_accessor_builder.

defaulting_notes: enable_preload defaults to true in Configuration.php but false in bundled sample YAML and README examples.
template_language_version defaults to 7.4 even though composer.json requires PHP ^8.3.

cross_module_relationships.relationship: Registers command services and binds configured schema_files/schema_type into command constructors.
Registers SchemaCacheWarmer with the selected builders and config values.
Docs explain how consuming apps use generated artifacts and configure generation inputs.

state_and_persistence_model.generated_files: Type registry and generated GraphQL PHP classes are written to the consumer-specified dir path.
state_and_persistence_model.schema_source: GraphQL SDL files resolved from the consumer-specified schema_files glob or file path.

integration_boundaries.description: Supplies config, bin/console runtime, optional GraphQL HTTP controller, schema files, and generated output directory.
Provides builders, schema utilities, resolver interfaces, and federation extension helpers used by the bundle.
